emailCampaignsRecipientPreviewAsOfNow: This resolves the audience as of now. Sending resolves it again and freezes that list.
emailCampaignsRecipientPreviewNoAudience: This campaign has no audience yet. Choose one in the composer to preview its recipients.
emailCampaignsRecipientPreviewRecipients: The audience reaches no customers right now.
emailCampaignsRecipientPreviewSharedEmai: No two customers share an email address.

emailCampaignsRecipientPreviewUnavailabl: Recipients couldn't be resolved because Dotypos is unavailable. Nothing was changed.
emailCampaignsSendConfirmCodeInvalid: Enter the 8-character code from the latest test email.
emailCampaignsSendConfirmDescription: Type the confirmation code from the latest test email. The code works for 24 hours and only for the content that test showed. A newer test send or a content change replaces it.
emailCampaignsSendConfirmFailed: The campaign could not be sent. Try again.
emailCampaignsSendConfirmIrreversible: Sending freezes the recipient list and can't be undone.
emailCampaignsSendConfirmUnsavedChanges: Save your changes and send a new test first. The campaign sends only saved content.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureAudienceMiss: Choose an audience for this campaign before sending it.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureAudienceNotF: This campaign's audience no longer exists. Choose another audience; nothing was sent and the code still works.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureCampaignRead: This campaign already left Draft. Duplicate it to send a new copy.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureCodeContentC: The campaign changed after that test email. Send a new test email and use its code.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureCodeExpired: That code expired. Send a new test email to get a fresh code.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureCodeSupersed: A newer test email replaced that code. Use the code from the latest test email.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureCodeTooManyA: Too many wrong codes, so that code no longer works. Send a new test email to get a fresh code.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureCodeUnknown: That code doesn't match the latest test email. Check it for typos and try again.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureConfigError: Campaign sending isn't configured correctly for this deployment. Ask a developer to check its environment variables.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureContentMissi: Add a subject and body in at least one language first.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureDatabaseUnav: Recipients couldn't be resolved because the database is unavailable. Nothing was sent and the code still works; try again in a moment.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureDeliveryQueu: Delivery couldn't be queued, so the campaign is marked Failed. Retry undelivered recipients in a moment.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureDotyposUnava: Recipients couldn't be resolved because Dotypos is unavailable. Nothing was sent and the code still works; try again in a moment.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureEmailDeliver: The email provider didn't accept the test email. Try again in a moment.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureEmailNotConf: Campaign email isn't configured for this deployment. Ask a developer to set {variables}.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureFallbackCont: Customers without content in their language get the Czech version, so add Czech content, or restrict the audience to one language this campaign has. Nothing was sent.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureNoRecipients: The audience has no reachable recipients right now, so nothing was sent.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureNotRetryable: Only a failed campaign can retry undelivered recipients.

match.countPlural=other: Outside production, campaign email can only go to @{domain} addresses, and {count} addresses are outside it. Nothing was sent.

emailCampaignsSendingFailureSigningKeyIn: Confirmation codes can't be issued because the signing secret is misconfigured. Ask a developer to check BETTER_AUTH_SECRETS.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureSiteUrlNotCo: The test email couldn't be built because the site URL isn't configured. Ask a developer to check the deployment's URL settings.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureUnauthorized: Your admin sign-in is no longer valid. Reload the page and sign in again.
emailCampaignsSendingFailureUnexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
emailCampaignsSentAudienceFilterCountedB: {filter}, counted back from the send time ({sentAt}).
emailCampaignsSentDeliveryUnconfirmedNot: Unconfirmed recipients may already have the email: the provider never confirmed their batch. Retry undelivered skips them unless you also choose to resend to them.
emailCampaignsSentDuplicateFailed: The campaign could not be duplicated.
emailCampaignsSentEmailRenderFailed: The email could not be rendered.
emailCampaignsSentFailedNotice: Delivery failed for some recipients. Retry undelivered sends only to recipients who didn't get the email.
emailCampaignsSentIncludeUnconfirmed: Also resend to unconfirmed recipients (they may receive it twice)
emailCampaignsSentNoSendRecorded: No send was recorded for this campaign.
emailCampaignsSentRetryFailed: Undelivered recipients could not be retried.
emailCampaignsSentSendingNotice: Delivery is in progress. Recipient statuses update as the email provider reports them.
emailCampaignsTestSendAdminInboxAlways: The admin inbox always receives test emails.
emailCampaignsTestSendContentMissing: Add a subject and body in at least one language before sending a test.
emailCampaignsTestSendDescription: Test emails carry the confirmation code you type to send the campaign. A new test send replaces the previous code.
emailCampaignsTestSendFailed: The test email could not be sent. Check the addresses and try again.
emailCampaignsTestSendPerLanguage: Each address gets one [TEST] email per language:
emailCampaignsTestSendUnsavedChanges: Save your changes first. A test send uses the saved campaign, so its code wouldn't confirm your unsaved edits.
